title: MobRelics
description: This plugin adds a new enchantment called Relics Law and a customizable drop rate of spawn eggs dropped by mobs when unalived by a player each mob can be customized individually.
body: This is the first release of a amazing plugin for paper servers that have a economy and allows the sales of spawners. This plugin adds a new enchantment called SilkPro that can only be added to a netherite pickax, this enchantment gives players the ability to mine spawners in two different ways. First way is by standing, this will give the player a plain spawner and the second way is by crouching, this gives the player the spawner with the mob preserved in the spawner. This plugin also adds a fully customizable drop rate for spawn eggs that can be dropped by mobs when unalived by a player. This adds a whole new way to be the richest player on servers if you farm!
